tool_args.rationale: Responses are concave in u_now near s_grad≈1, while low-gradient rows are elevated and high-gradient rows suppressed. A saturating-plus-square-root substrate response with an exponential gradient modulation captures these smooth trends; the current observations cover the distinct regimes, so another probe is deferred.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The ten observations already span low, near-unit, and elevated gradient regimes, breaking the original ambiguity without further measurement cost.
At comparable u values, outputs vary strongly with s_grad; a substrate-only law cannot explain the cross-regime shifts.
The near-unit-gradient response is concave and the strong low/high-gradient changes are not adequately represented by a simple multiplicative power dependence.
The available high-gradient observations are below its stated critical-gradient range, so that branch is not supported by these measurements.
